_comment: Map Feishu chat_id -> target string. The target is passed as-is to your handler.
_comment2: Copy this file to routing.json and fill in your chat IDs.
_comment3: Mute: set a chat's target to "mute" (or __mute__|drop|discard), list ids under "_mute", or set BRIDGE_MUTED_CHATS. Muted chats are not delivered.
